## About
Garageworks is an auto body and paint shop on W Winton Ave in Hayward. Linh and the crew take on everything from a single bumper to repainting an entire car and custom body work.
One reviewer put it simply: Linh prioritizes quality first and makes sure the job is done right. Another said the paint matching on their bumper was spot on.
We have a 5 star rating from 23 Google reviews. If you have a project in mind or a question about your car, give us a call.

## Services
- Custom paint and show quality work: Custom paint and body work for cars you want to stand out. One reviewer called the results better than OEM quality.
- Widebody installs: One reviewer had a widebody installed and their entire car repainted.
- Bumper and carbon lip repair and paint: Repair and paint for front bumpers and carbon lips.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Our listed hours are Thursday from 10 AM to 4 PM. We're closed the other days of the week, so call ahead.

Q: Is there a wait to get my car in?
A: Sometimes there's a waitlist. One reviewer said it was worth the wait.

Q: Can you fix work another shop got wrong?
A: Yes. One customer brought in a car with someone else's bad work and we made it right.
